brief: Classical RPG drawing room: eight engraved medallions, woven ivory/green checkerboard, fluted brass floor lamp with levitating apple, framed cloud carrying stone and stair climbing toward a green moon. Restrained black, bronze, green and ivory. No gradients in the interface.
